create_layerselect_instance: create a LayerSelect module with num_layers and num_logits for Gumbel-Sigmoid sampling
sample_layer_logits: sample layer logits using LayerSelect.sample with a given logit index
forward_layer_select: forward a layer index through LayerSelect to get the sampled residual weight
gumbel_sigmoid_sampling: compute Gumbel-Sigmoid samples from logits with configurable temperature and hard selection
review_layerselect_class: review the LayerSelect class and its Gumbel-Sigmoid sampling for neural architecture search
